services.title: Services
services.lead: Three things I get hired for. Each one is backed by a system on this site that is running in production right now.
services.engagementBody: Fixed-scope projects for a defined build, or a monthly retainer when the system needs someone who keeps it running. Either way you deal with the person writing the code — there is no account manager in between, and no handover to a team you have not met.
services.pricing: No price list. A number without a scope is either an underquote I regret or an overquote that loses the conversation. Tell me the problem and what it currently costs you, and you get a real figure within two working days.
services.ctaTitle: Describe the problem, not the solution
services.ctaBody: The most useful first message is what is going wrong and what it costs you. I will tell you honestly whether I am the right person for it.

platform.title: Platform
platform.lead: An AI-assisted WhatsApp conversation platform for businesses whose customers already message them — one inbox, one catalogue, one set of rules, and a model that answers when it should and steps aside when it should not.
platform.complianceBody: The platform is built on the official Meta WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API) and the Meta Graph API. It respects the 24-hour customer service window in code rather than by staff discipline: outside the window only templates approved by Meta are sent, opt-out is honoured on the first request, and every message the platform sends is attributable to a business the customer chose to contact.
platform.ctaTitle: See whether it fits your operation
platform.ctaBody: The fastest way to find out is to describe how customers reach you today and where the work piles up. You get an honest answer about fit, not a demo script.
